scope.power: 整数与分数底数，指数2至4；负底数、奇偶次方、零和括号外负号。
scope.mixed: 括号、四则运算、2至3次方及括号内和差的平方；同级从左到右；除数不为零。
excluded: 零指数、负指数、分数指数
数轴、分类及完整有理数章节

validation.browser: T3 collaborative browser; normal UI button/keyboard events; no answer, score or timer modification
validation.storage: Baseline save copied to LAN origin as a test fixture; subsequent same-origin artifact updates and language switches retained old/new records. No domain migration feature implemented.
validation.locale: Chinese/Japanese switch retained six history IDs, power count 7, mixed count 28, empty review queue

prePublicationProductionBaseline.practice: Six rational-division questions; one mistake; 100 points; one review question; refresh retained both records
